=== Safety and Security ===

* Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
* Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
* Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

This 2023 Dodge Durango R/T delivers a commanding presence on the road with its muscular design and proven capability. Gray Destroyer Clearcoat exterior combined with distinctive Orange Sport Package styling creates an unmistakable appearance that commands attention wherever you travel.

- HEMI 5.7L V8 Multi Displacement VVT engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission
- AWD capability for enhanced traction and control
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 10.1" touchscreen display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Full Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus with Adaptive Cruise Control and Stop
- Heated and ventilated front seats with power 8-way driver memory seating
- Heated second row seats for passenger comfort
- Premium leather-trimmed bucket seats with orange accent stitching
- 20" Black Noise aluminum wheels
- ParkView rear backup camera with parking assistance
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with emergency communication system
- Heated steering wheel and power tilt/telescopic steering column

The interior reflects thoughtful design with six-passenger seating arranged across three rows, providing flexibility for family or cargo needs. Captain's chairs in the second row feature fold and tumble capability, while the third row split-bench seats expand your carrying options. Climate control extends throughout the cabin with front dual-zone automatic temperature management, rear air conditioning, and rear window defroster ensuring comfort for all occupants during any season.

Driving dynamics are enhanced through four-wheel independent suspension with rear load leveling, electronic stability control, and speed-sensing steering that adapts to road conditions. The all-wheel-drive system provides confidence in varied weather and terrain, while the 3.09 rear axle ratio balances performance with efficiency. Anti-roll bars at both front and rear work with the suspension to maintain composed handling during cornering and lane changes.

Safety features are comprehensively integrated throughout the vehicle. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags create a protective cabin environment. Electronic braking assistance with four-wheel disc brakes and ABS provides responsive stopping power, while traction control and electronic stability systems actively work to maintain vehicle control in challenging situations.

The premium audio system features nine speakers with SiriusXM 360L capabilities, while the navigation system with TomTom mapping keeps you oriented and on course. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls, remote keyless entry with garage door transmitter functionality, and the 115V auxiliary power outlet add daily convenience to ownership.

This vehicle is located at our Webster store. Please call for more information.

Sophisticated from every angle, this 2019 Audi A7 Premium Plus combines the presence of a luxury sedan with the sweeping silhouette and versatility of a Sportback. Finished in elegant Vesuvius Gray Metallic and riding on striking 20-inch 5-Double-V-Spoke wheels, the A7 carries a distinctly modern presence. The desirable S Line Package sharpens that appearance even further with an S Line exterior treatment, illuminated door sills, signature fender badging, and a sport suspension lowered by 20mm for a more athletic stance and driving character.

Inside, the A7 showcases Audi's talent for blending technology with understated luxury. The Premium Plus Package brings the impressive 12.3-inch Audi Virtual Cockpit digital instrument cluster, Matrix-design headlights with High-Beam Assistant, wireless charging through the Audi Phone Box, and a Bang & Olufsen 3D Premium Sound System featuring 16 speakers. Contrast stitching throughout the door panels, armrests, and knee bolsters adds another layer of craftsmanship, while the Top View Camera System with Virtual 360 View makes maneuvering this sophisticated grand tourer remarkably effortless.

This A7 is also exceptionally well equipped with driver-assistance technology. The available Driver Assistance Package adds Adaptive Cruise Control with Traffic Jam Assist, Audi Active Lane Assist, Intersection Assist, Traffic Sign Recognition, Turn Assist, and Emergency Assist. Audi Side Assist with Rear Cross Traffic Assist, Pre Sense Rear, and Vehicle Exit Warning provide additional awareness, creating a luxury car designed to make both long-distance touring and everyday driving more relaxing.

Comfort continues through every season with the Cold Weather Package, adding a heated steering wheel and heated rear seats for passengers. Audi Beam Rings project the iconic four-ring logo beneath the front and rear doors after dark, while the Audi Guard Protection Kit adds all-weather floor mats and a cargo mat to help preserve the beautifully appointed interior.

With its Vesuvius Gray finish, S Line styling, 20-inch wheels, advanced driver-assistance technology, Virtual Cockpit, and premium Bang & Olufsen audio, this 2019 Audi A7 Premium Plus is an exceptional example of Audi's modern grand touring philosophy. Elegant enough for an upscale evening, practical enough for everyday life, and athletic enough to make the road itself part of the experience, the A7 delivers luxury without sacrificing personality.

We've just taken in a 2025 Chevrolet Trax 2RS SUV - it's finished in Crimson Metallic with a Jet Black interior featuring bold Red accents that perfectly complement its sporty RS styling.

With 42,896 miles, a fuel-efficient 1.2L turbocharged 3-cylinder gasoline engine, smooth 6-speed automatic transmission, and front-wheel drive, this Trax delivers an engaging drive while returning an EPA-estimated 28 MPG city and 32 MPG highway.

It has a clean, accident-free history, has had two previous owners, is in Good condition, and still benefits from the remaining factory powertrain warranty for added peace of mind.

If you're looking for a stylish crossover that's easy to park, enjoyable to drive, and loaded with premium technology, this Trax 2RS checks all the right boxes. Its aggressive RS appearance package, striking 19-inch black machined aluminum wheels, black exterior accents, LED lighting, black roof rails, and rear spoiler create a sporty look that stands out whether you're commuting downtown or pulling into your favorite weekend destination.

Slip inside and you'll find a cabin that feels far more upscale than you'd expect. The heated Evotex seats help chase away cold mornings, while the heated flat-bottom steering wheel adds another touch of comfort every time you head out.

The 8-way power driver's seat with power lumbar support helps you settle into the perfect driving position, making long trips and daily commutes equally enjoyable. The available power sunroof fills the cabin with natural light and fresh air, making every drive feel a little more open and inviting.

Technology is front and center thanks to the large 11-inch HD touchscreen with wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto, allowing your favorite apps, navigation, music, and messages to appear seamlessly without plugging in. Wireless charging helps eliminate clutter, while Remote Start lets you warm up or cool down the cabin before you even step outside.

Adaptive Cruise Control makes highway travel more relaxing by automatically adjusting your speed with traffic ahead. Forward Collision Alert, Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Front Pedestrian Braking, IntelliBeam automatic high beams, and the Following Distance Indicator all work together to help you stay aware of your surroundings.

The Driver Confidence Package adds even more reassurance with Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Rear Park Assist, and an HD Rear Vision Camera that makes parking in crowded lots simple.

Practicality hasn't been forgotten either. The versatile 60/40 split-folding rear seat expands your cargo space in seconds, while the cargo privacy cover helps keep your belongings out of sight. Automatic climate control, keyless open and push-button start, deep-tinted rear glass, active noise cancellation, SiriusXM capability, and built-in Wi-Fi hotspot capability round out an exceptionally well-equipped package.

At Huebner Chevrolet Subaru, we make buying your next vehicle simple with transparent pricing, financing options tailored to your needs, available protection plans, and free delivery within 150 miles. description: Discover the 2018 Honda Pilot EX-L, a versatile and well-equipped SUV that combines reliability with comfort. Finished in elegant White Diamond Pearl, this used Honda Pilot offers a powerful 3.5-liter V6 engine paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, making it ideal for both city driving and off-road adventures. With just under 97,147 miles, this SUV features a spacious interior with a third-row seat, heated leather seats, and a sunroof to enhance your driving experience. Convenience is key, with keyless entry, push start, rear A/C, fog lights, and a backup camera that makes parking and navigation effortless. This Honda Pilot EX-L is packed with features designed for safety, comfort, and convenience. It includes advanced safety systems such as four-wheel ABS, cornering brake control, and an auto-locking power door lock system, providing peace of mind on every journey. The vehicle's anti-lockout door locks further enhance security, ensuring you and your passengers are protected at all times. Whether navigating busy streets or open highways, this SUV delivers a confident and secure drive, making it a smart choice for families and commuters alike. 2018 Honda Pilot Safety and Security Features This vehicle is equipped with essential safety features including four-wheel ABS, which provides reliable stopping power in diverse conditions. Power door locks with anti-lockout functionality prevent accidental lock-ins, while cornering brake control enhances stability during turns. The auto-locking door system adds an extra layer of security, ensuring doors lock automatically when driving, helping keep all occupants safe. 2018 Honda Pilot Entertainment and Technology Features Enjoy a range of entertainment and tech options in this Honda Pilot, starting with voice-operated hands-free phone call integration and radio, allowing safe, hands-free communication and audio control. Pandora internet radio offers endless streaming options via the 8-inch touchscreen display, which acts as the central hub for all media. The system includes a single subwoofer and six speakers, providing clear, immersive sound. Additional features include an auxiliary USB input, electronic messaging assistance with read function, and a user-friendly touch screen interface, making every drive enjoyable and connected. 2018 Honda Pilot Performance Features Under the hood, this Pilot features cylinder deactivation technology, enhancing fuel efficiency during highway cruising. The SUV's on-demand 4WD system ensures optimal traction and stability in varying terrains and weather conditions, giving you confidence wherever your journey takes you. These performance features combine to deliver a balanced mix of power, efficiency, and control, making this Honda Pilot a dependable choice for daily driving and weekend adventures.

The Odyssey delivers highway efficiency at 28 mpg combined with city capability at 19 mpg, powered by a 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Safety features include four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and a comprehensive airbag system with dual front impact and side impact bags, plus overhead airbags for added protection.

This minivan represents an established choice for families who value dependability and straightforward utility. Contact us today to arrange a test drive and see how the Odyssey EX-L fits your transportation needs.
